commands.command: cargo clippy --lib --all-features -- -D warnings -D unsafe_code -D clippy::unwrap_used -D clippy::expect_used -D clippy::panic -D clippy::todo -D clippy::unimplemented -D clippy::indexing_slicing -D clippy::get_unwrap -D clippy::arithmetic_side_effects -D clippy::as_conversions

rules_satisfied: No unchecked indexing or unchecked arithmetic
Empty input returns ParseError::Empty before any parsing
try_reserve used before allocation with Allocation error on failure
max_items enforced before push with TooMany error
Parse errors mapped via map_err to ParseError::Invalid
Empty trimmed tokens rejected as Invalid
Functional Core: parse_shards is pure logic with no hidden I/O
Typed error taxonomy: Empty, Invalid, TooMany, Allocation
residual_risk: None. All absolute law violations removed. Parser enforces empty check, max_items cap, try_reserve, and typed error mapping. Tests confirm correct behavior.
